summary: @ornikar/prettier-config ships obfuscated preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes concealed payload
details: Package advertised as a Prettier configuration ships two obfuscated files that execute on `npm install`. package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style `_0x488df8`/`_0x52943e` hex identifiers and per-function string proxy maps concealing the strings `bun`, `unzip`, and `bun-dl-`; it detects platform/musl, downloads a Bun runtime ZIP from oven-sh GitHub releases, extracts it via native `unzip`/PowerShell/JS ZIP parser, chmod +x the binary, and then execFileSyncs `math_init.js` under the freshly-dropped Bun binary. The 727KB sibling `math_init.js` is a compiled Bun bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) wrapped in a rotating string-array decoder (`WV8StW` rotator, `n7gIxM` numeric array, `hc1jfK9` decoder). Executing the payload under Bun rather than Node evades Node-based supply-chain scanners. A Prettier config package has no legitimate reason to download an alternate JavaScript runtime or ship a 727KB obfuscated compiled Bun bundle at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
